field_matching.raw: Unicode NFC plus trim/collapse whitespace; preserve case and accents
field_matching.normalized: exact string equality against independently prepared normalized GT

ground_truth_status.unresolved_normalized_gt: masked from normalized metrics but retained in raw metrics

document_exact_match: all four fields correct on documents where all four slots are evaluable
entity_matching: exact field class and exact [start,end) boundary; wrong class or boundary is FP+FN
macro_policy: mean over fields where the metric is defined
baseline_validation: exporter ready; values remain NOT_RUN until T13 predictions exist
